lp_disagree_large:nkm: knife edge of the 'approx' class: one binding period starts/ends one period apart (regime count differs by 1, or same count with shifted sequence). Size 0.15-0.4, i.e. larger than the documented ~0.12. Period 21 of the sample at line t=0.1 (A#6) differs; filtered shock differs by 0.04.
lp_disagree_large:nkms: same knife edge as for nkm (3-parameter model); also seen at news MCMC draws (replay under occbin, part B) and at a news posterior mode (0.23 with equal binding-period count but a shifted sequence)
regime_seq_differs_equal_lp: equal log posterior to 1e-15 relative (lp = -8.5e14 at an absurd vector); one period flips: knife edge
finite_vs_inf:occbin_finite_news: wrong-result (news refuses a point OccBin evaluates)

news horizon 40 too short at extreme vectors (filtered shocks of size 100+, spells longer than 40): horizon 80 gives the OccBin value to 1e-11. The filter reports the generic code 304; the message does not say that the horizon is the cause (trial points fail with 313, 168 of them at the first failing period)
finite_vs_inf:news_finite_occbin: wrong-result (occbin refuses a point news evaluates)
OccBin's failure codes (304 via 310/311/313) at points where the news filter finds a solution; the counterpart of the previous kind; expected at cycling/periodic guess-and-verify failures
variant_fails_where_news_ok: obc_selection='longest' (and 'shortest') can fail the filter (304) where the default selection succeeds: a different (longer) spell makes the root search fail; not a bug as such
lp_absurd: FALSE POSITIVE of an early threshold (|lp|>1e6): legitimate huge negative values from tiny shock standard deviations (-3e10 ... -2e12). Threshold changed to lp>1e5; huge negative values are counted separately
milp_timeout_hit: only in the opt-in configuration est.obc_milp_time_limit=1.0 (default 0): up to 96 integer programmes per evaluation, each running to its 1 s limit -> one evaluation 45 s (bf) or > 40 s (nkm); 'rescued' stays 0. Documented cost of the option
slow_failure: evaluations/simulations that fail after > 5 s (A) or > 10 s (C): OccBin inversion-filter failures with huge regime-guess tries (see memory_jump), the opt-in MILP configuration, and RegimeOBC's 30 s integer-programme limit (sw model: 30 s for one failing period)
memory_jump: Occbin.rules' memo trie (pydyn/occbin.py:260) is unbounded: at extreme parameter vectors OccBin's filter builds 232,740 rule nodes in one Occbin instance (1.3 GB peak, 10 s, then fails with 304). Seen 6+ times in A, C and D (the events listed under B, C, D with 1.0-1.1 GB are the same process memory after an A event: an artefact of the first version of the detector). The news solver needs 0.5 s at the same vector. Python does not return the memory to the OS: the process stays at ~1.4 GB
discontinuity_same_regimes: a steep but smooth slope far from the mode (bf, -1283 -> -840 within 0.05 of the line parameter, 11 sub-steps all smooth, same regimes). Detector changed to compare with neighbouring steps
path_disagree:nkm: the 'approx' constraint class: paths differ by 1e-5 relative in a long run once a knife-edge period flips (shock scale >= 2 x sd, 1000-period segments); regimes differ in that period
path_disagree:bf: bf (two equations switch): OccBin binds for one period with rnot - rlb = -2e-6, news does not bind (rnot - rlb = +2e-5): each satisfies its own regime condition; the paths differ by 0.006 although the two sit at the boundary: a jump across the constraint, i.e. two solutions
path_disagree:sw: SW model has several equilibria (tests document it); paths 0.08 apart (0.5%) with different regimes. Not minimised
regime_history_differs_equal_path: regime histories differ in the knife-edge period while paths agree to 1e-6
one_method_fails: OccBin guess-and-verify cycles (error 310) or news reports horizon_too_short/no_solution on one side only; counted per 1000-period segment (counts are segments, not events)
nonbitwise_ulp: two constructions of HigherOrderNews on identical inputs in one process give results differing at 1e-16..1e-18, not bitwise (rounding order, probably BLAS alignment / threading-free kernels); all differences < 1e-9. No nondeterminism of the order-1 or the filter calls (see determinism counts)
mode_search_unfinished_90s: csminwel with the news likelihood from random starts does not stop within 90 s: 2,700 evaluations at 33 ms each, still improving (lp 1679.9); not a hang (soak/repro/mode_search_slow.py). The known non-convergence of csminwel on the NKM posterior
warning:RuntimeWarning: invalid value en: Estimation.laplace takes sqrt of the diagonal of an inverse Hessian that is not positive definite at the mode csminwel reached (estimation.py:1754, outside the OBC code; the result is NaN, handled)
timeout: per-evaluation 40-60 s timer fired: the opt-in MILP configuration (A#105: 80 MILP time-outs)
